items.title: BI is dead. Dashboards aren't. - ODSC WEST 2026
items.summary: AI can generate a dashboard. But turning data into insight still takes a team. Insight should be self-serve.In this demo talk at ODSC AI West 2026, I shared what customer feedback taught us about building a data agent for teams. Dashboards do more than monitor metrics. Building and exploring them helps people and AI understand the data and discover new questions.https://www.squadbase.dev/
